text:
maria: Quick brainstorm: we need a succinct benchmark narrative for launch — single hero claim, 3 reproducible charts, and a 30-min webinar. Thinking tactical, demo-forward.

sam: Agree. Hero claim should be conditional and verifiable. Suggested hooks: tokens->$ (per-1k), p50 vs p99 tail risk, and cost-per-response at common batch sizes.

maria: Hero chart idea: x-axis = $/1k tokens, y-axis = median latency (ms). Lines for config variants (redwood-optimized, open-default). Add two callouts (chat-512, long-context-2048).

tess: Webinar run: 10m findings, 10m demo (batching + prefix cache + quant), 10m Q&A. Demo needs a script that ops teams can copy-paste.

leo: Routing rules: if downloads_pdf OR clicks_dedicated then AE+SE outreach. Webinar attendees from companies >250 get prioritized AE touch. Add "primary use case" to form.

zach: Microcopy options for hero: "Faster inference, smarter economics." / "Same latency, lower cost." Test both in modal CTA.

maria: Chart deep-dives: 1) tail latency (p50,p95,p99) vs percentile for redwood vs comp; 2) throughput econ: cost per 1k responses by batch size. Include hardware assumptions and prompt length.

sam: Methodology note: link to eval scripts and dataset slice. Use conservative phrasing: "Up to 5x in our testbeds; typical 2x-3x with batch+cache."

tess: I'll write the demo scripts and runbook snippets. Want them short, command-first, then explanation.

leo: I'll draft routing JSON and QA the event wiring with product.

zach: I'll set up the hero microcopy A/B in the signup modal and capture CTR + conversion.

ops-bot: Webinar created: https://cal.link/redwood-bench-launch — slots Tue/Wed/Thu.

maria: Action list: sam -> blog lead + chart svgs; tess -> demo scripts; leo -> routing JSON; zach -> microcopy test; maria -> slides + one-pager. Target: drafts in 48 hours.

sam: On it, will push SVG mocks and a 2-paragraph lead by EOD tomorrow.

maria: Great — keep claims reproducible and conservative. Ping here for blockers. :thumbsup:
